name: webfetch
description: License-first image search and download for agents. Federates open-license, museum, archive, stock and editorial image providers, ranks CC0 and public-domain results first, rejects results with an unknown license by default, and returns a license tag, confidence score and attribution line with each result. Wikimedia Commons, Openverse and several other providers work without an API key.

UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY.description: Unsplash API access key; enables the Unsplash provider.

PEXELS_API_KEY.description: Pexels API key; enables the Pexels provider.

PIXABAY_API_KEY.description: Pixabay API key; enables the Pixabay provider.

BRAVE_API_KEY.description: Brave Search API key; enables Brave web image search.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Spotify client ID; enables artist and album images from Spotify.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Spotify client secret; used with SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.

BING_API_KEY.description: Bing image search API key (opt-in provider).

SERPAPI_KEY.description: SerpAPI key for Google Images and reverse image lookup (opt-in provider).
